note: Blocker scopes are joined, not summed. A Master Library source gap, a legal-design blocker and a mapping blocker are different questions about the same build and are counted separately; the joined unique count deduplicates by dedupeKey so one issue appearing in a state review and in the edition's gap ledger is counted once. No total here is hard-coded in application logic.

The amount of the non-judicial personnel charge actually imposed. 2026 Senate Bill 430 carries the supreme court's authority to impose a charge not exceeding $19 per case from July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2030, but the amount currently imposed must be confirmed before a total is quoted.

Whether the Kansas Judicial Council will permit LegalEase to generate and deliver its copyrighted expungement forms in a paid packet. Which Kansas municipal courts publish their own current expungement forms or require their own process, and which govern expungement by charter ordinance rather than by K.S.A. 12-4516 directly. The municipal filing fee. K.S.A. 12-4516(g)(2) lets a municipal court prescribe a fee to be charged as costs, and the amount varies court by court with no statewide figure. No figure may be quoted until the participant's court is known.
